verdict.rationale: Carta's docs state that law firms and technology partners can fetch cap table information on behalf of the company, and that personal-finance partners can aggregate equity holdings. Access runs through OAuth 2.0 (AUTHORIZATION_CODE and CLIENT_CREDENTIALS grants) with configurable OAuth scopes, which supports scoped delegated access without sharing admin credentials. Missing for 10: detail on how fine-grained scopes are and how a company grants or revokes third-party consent, explicit HRIS-vendor support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
